data.name: AbsolutePathRequired
data.value: The path "{0}" must be absolute. Write an absolute task assembly or working directory path in the invocation file.
data.comment: {0} is a path supplied by the invocation.

data.name: ConflictingPath
data.value: The declared path "{0}" has conflicting input/output ownership. Duplicate outputs and in-place updates are not supported.
data.comment: {0} is a declared file path.

data.name: DuplicateParameter
data.value: The name "{0}" occurs more than once. Parameter and metadata names must be unique ignoring case.
data.comment: {0} is a parameter or metadata name.

data.name: EngineDependencyNotSupported
data.value: The task assembly "{0}" requires Microsoft.Build. Standalone actions cannot load the MSBuild engine.
data.comment: {0} is the task assembly path. Do not translate Microsoft.Build.

data.name: ErrorEvent
data.comment: Diagnostic format: {0} file, {1} line, {2} column, {3} error code, {4} message. Preserve the diagnostic keyword "error".

data.name: ExactPathRequired
data.value: The declared path "{0}" contains a wildcard. Supply exact, enumerated file paths.
data.comment: {0} is a declared file path.

data.name: InvalidInvocation
data.value: The invocation file "{0}" must contain a JSON invocation object.
data.comment: {0} is the invocation file path.

data.name: InvalidEnvironmentValue
data.value: The environment variable "{0}" has a null value. Supply a string value or omit the variable.
data.comment: {0} is an environment variable name.

data.name: InvalidContract
data.value: The task "{0}" has an invalid DeclaredIO annotation. MSBuildDeclaredIORequiresUnsetAttribute must specify one parameter name.
data.comment: {0} is the task type. Do not translate DeclaredIO or MSBuildDeclaredIORequiresUnsetAttribute.

data.name: InvalidParameter
data.value: The parameter "{0}" is not a writable task parameter of "{1}". Supply a public task parameter, not a host service.
data.comment: {0} is a parameter name; {1} is the task type.

data.name: InvalidParameterValue
data.value: The value for parameter "{0}" cannot be bound to "{1}". Supply a supported scalar, array, or item value.
data.comment: {0} is a parameter name; {1} is its expected .NET type.

data.name: InvalidSourceLocation
data.value: Invocation lineNumber and columnNumber must not be negative.
data.comment: Do not translate the JSON property names lineNumber and columnNumber.

data.name: InvalidTaskType
data.value: The type "{0}" must be a public, concrete ITask implementation.
data.comment: {0} is the task type. Do not translate ITask.

data.name: InvocationFailed
data.value: Task invocation "{0}" failed: {1}
data.comment: {0} is the invocation file path; {1} is the exception, including its details.

data.name: MissingContract
data.value: The task "{0}" has no DeclaredIO contract. Use a task annotated with MSBuildDeclaredIOTaskAttribute.
data.comment: {0} is the task type. Do not translate DeclaredIO or MSBuildDeclaredIOTaskAttribute.

data.name: MissingDeclarations
data.value: The task "{0}" must explicitly bind both DeclaredInputs and DeclaredOutputs as item arrays.
data.comment: {0} is the task type. Do not translate DeclaredInputs or DeclaredOutputs.

data.name: NestedBuildNotSupported
data.value: BuildProjectFile is not supported by standalone task hosts. Expand child builds during graph construction.
data.comment: Do not translate BuildProjectFile.

data.name: ParameterMustBeUnset
data.value: The parameter "{0}" must be unset or empty for this task's DeclaredIO contract.
data.comment: {0} is a parameter name. Do not translate DeclaredIO.

data.name: PersistentOutputRequired
data.value: The action "{0}" must declare a persistent regular-file output. Zero-I/O invocations belong in graph construction.
data.comment: {0} is the task type.

data.name: RegularFileRequired
data.value: The required declared file "{0}" is missing or is not a regular file. Check the invocation's inputs and outputs.
data.comment: {0} is a declared file path.

data.name: RequiredParameter
data.value: The required parameter "{0}" was not supplied for task "{1}". Add it to the invocation parameters.
data.comment: {0} is a parameter name; {1} is the task type.

data.name: TaskFailed
data.value: The task "{0}" returned false without logging an error.
data.comment: {0} is the task type.

data.name: UnsupportedParameterType
data.value: The parameter type "{0}" is not supported by the standalone host.
data.comment: {0} is a .NET type name.

data.name: UnsupportedTaskHosting
data.value: The task "{0}" requires "{1}", which is not supported by the standalone host.
data.comment: {0} is a task type; {1} is a task-hosting attribute type.

data.name: UnsupportedVersion
data.value: The invocation version "{0}" is unsupported. Write a version 1 invocation file.
data.comment: {0} is the invocation format version.

data.name: Usage
data.value: Usage: MSBuild.ActionTaskHost --invocation <invocation.json>
data.comment: Do not translate the executable name or the --invocation option.

data.name: WarningEvent
data.comment: Diagnostic format: {0} file, {1} line, {2} column, {3} warning code, {4} message. Preserve the diagnostic keyword "warning".
